Title: Azure Maps events in Azure Event Grid

Body.Content:
Azure Maps now integrates with Azure Event Grid so you can respond to geofence events to send event notifications to other services and trigger downstream processes. With this integration, you can react to events when an asset enters a geofence, exits a geofence, or when a geofencing query returns a result.

Learn more about reacting to Azure Maps events using Event Grid
